title: Fourier coefficient of a coordinate subcube
statement: Let $C\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be a set of coordinates, and let $b,\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The absolute value of the Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the indicator of the subcube whose coordinates in $C$ agree with $b$ is $2^{-|C|}$ if the support of $\gamma$ is contained in $C$, and is zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a finite set of coordinates among $1,\ldots,n$
